text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey hasn't shown up for training despite the scheduled time.
When I went looking for her, she was in the committee room.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please place anything that requires review today on my desk.
I have emailed everyone the list of new intermediary agencies, so please check it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
Oh my, is it this late already...?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I was so absorbed in my work that I didn't notice.
I am terribly sorry. I'll be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey offered a heartfelt apology.
To prevent anything similar from happening again,
I made sure to issue a firm warning.
